commentary.text: 90+11' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+9' None of the Alaves players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
90+8' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Alaves will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+7' Carles Alena (Getafe) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt.
90+6' Getafe are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
90+4' Miguel de la Fuente (Alaves) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
90+4' Djene (Getafe) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
90+3' Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
90+2' Substitution. Abdelkebir Abqar is replaced by Rafa Marin (Alaves).
90+2' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to make a change. Antonio Blanco (Alaves) replaces Carlos Benavidez.
90+1' Carles Alena (Getafe) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Antonio Sivera was alert and made a comfortable save.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.

90' Omar Alderete (Getafe) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar.
90' That's the end of the game for Borja Mayoral, who is replaced by Fabrizio Angileri (Getafe).
86' Luis Garcia Plaza prepares a substitution. Xeber Alkain is replaced by Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves).
86' It's time for a substitution. Miguel de la Fuente (Alaves) comes on in place of Ander Guevara.
84' 1 - 0 Goal! Borja Mayoral (Getafe) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Antonio Sivera to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
84' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
83' A yellow card for bad language! Xeber Alkain (Alaves) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
83' Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
82' Luis Garcia Plaza is stunned as referee Juan Martinez Munuera shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
82' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
81' Referee Juan Martinez Munuera makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
81' Dangerous play by Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves). Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY! One of the players from Getafe is about to take a penalty kick.
81' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
81' Looks like Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
80' A spell of possession for Getafe in an attempt to control the game.
77' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
76' The linesman referee is pointing towards the corner flag. It will be a corner kick.
76' The substitution is prepared. Samu (Alaves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kike Garcia.
75' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Getafe.
74' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Alaves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
72' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
71' Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
71' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Portu (Getafe).
70' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
69' Referee Juan Martinez Munuera sees the trip by Omar Alderete (Getafe) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Alaves.
69' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.

68' Omar Alderete (Getafe) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header, but it goes well wide of the left post.
66' Xeber Alkain (Alaves) rises above the defence inside the box, but his header flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
65' Juan Martinez Munuera has a clear sight and sees a foul from Carlos Benavidez (Alaves).

64' Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves) rises high to meet a perfect corner kick deep inside the box. He sends a header towards the top left corner but the goalkeeper reacts superbly to push the ball onto the post and out.
63' It will be a corner kick for Alaves.
62' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Omar Alderete (Getafe) replacing Stefan Mitrovic.
62' Here comes a substitution. Carles Alena (Getafe) is brought on as a substitute for Jaime Mata.
62' Poor challenge! Jaime Mata (Getafe) is penalised for tripping and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle.
61' Alaves string together a series of short passes.
59' The percentage of ball possession is – 45:55.

57' A precise cross towards the edge of the box was latched onto by Jon Guridi (Alaves) . He outjumped the defence and produced a powerful header which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
55' Juan Martinez Munuera interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves).
55' A quickly taken corner by Alaves.
54' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
53' Luis Rioja (Alaves) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
52' Xeber Alkain (Alaves) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
51' Getafe players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
49' Kike Garcia (Alaves) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
48' Good work from Getafe as they win a corner.
47' A header by Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) from very close range goes towards the crossbar, but doesn't get past Antonio Sivera, who makes a brilliant save.
46' Luis Rioja (Alaves) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Luis Rioja (Alaves) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Alaves, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
43' Luis Rioja (Alaves) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Juan Martinez Munuera has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
41' Xeber Alkain (Alaves) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
40' Stefan Mitrovic (Getafe) sends a long ball forward to Juanmi Latasa, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
39' The referee blows his whistle as Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves) was too aggressive in his challenge.
38' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
37' Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Juan Martinez Munuera saw the whole situation.
36' Jaime Mata (Getafe) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Antonio Sivera, who smothers the ball.
35' Xeber Alkain (Alaves) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
35' Alaves work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
33' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
32' Damian Suarez (Getafe) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul. Alaves have a free kick from a promising distance.
31' Xeber Alkain (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

30' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) latches on to a precise cross on the edge of the box and strikes the ball goalwards. However, it goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
29' Kike Garcia nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Jon Guridi (Alaves), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
29' David Soria steps in and intercepts a long pass from Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves).
27' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
26' Luis Rioja (Alaves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
25' A pass by Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
25' Alaves are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
24' Alaves quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
21' Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Getafe have a free kick.
19' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
18' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
17' Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves) commits a rough challenge and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) makes a strong challenge and Juan Martinez Munuera blows for a foul.

15' Stefan Mitrovic (Getafe) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
14' Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
12' Kike Garcia (Alaves) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
11' Luis Rioja (Alaves) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
10' The corner is swung in but Getafe can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
7' The Alaves players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
5' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Alaves is cautioned for aggressive play.
4' Kike Garcia (Alaves) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
4' Kike Garcia (Alaves) shows his incredible technical ability by sending the ball into free space and Luis Rioja latches onto his pass.
3' Jon Guridi (Alaves) is able to continue to play.
2' Jon Guridi (Alaves) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Alaves will kick the game off.
